com.sun.tools.hat.internal.model

类 Root

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.hat.internal.model.Root

  • public class Root
extends Object
    Represents a member of the rootset, that is, one of the objects that the GC starts from when marking reachable objects.
